task_production_rates.notes: Quick pass with duster or brush. Faster for open walls, slower for detailed areas. Rate assumes light dust, not heavy debris.
Pre-trim: Minimal obstructions. Ceiling line and corners only. Experienced painter with quality brush.
Post-trim: Slower due to cutting around baseboard, casing, outlets, switches. More precision required.
Roller application to wall field. Assumes cut-in complete. Open walls faster, cut-up rooms slower.
Spray application only (not including backroll). Very fast on open walls. Rate assumes experienced spray operator.
Backroll follows spray operator closely. Wet-on-wet mandatory. Rate accounts for keeping pace with sprayer.
Pre-trim: Perimeter cut-in only. Overhead work reduces rate vs wall cut-in.
Post-trim: Cutting around ceiling fixtures, HVAC registers. Overhead ergonomics + obstructions.
Ceiling roller with extension pole. ~25% slower than wall rolling due to overhead ergonomics.
Spray application only (not including backroll). Overhead spray requires controlled movement.
Backroll follows spray operator. Overhead work with extension pole. Must keep pace with sprayer.
Visual scan for holidays, flashing, runs. Good lighting required. QT4/QT5 task.
Spot work - highly variable. Rate assumes 5-10% of total area needs touch-up. If higher, re-evaluate prime quality.
Light hand sanding. QT4/QT5 task. Removes nibs and minor imperfections. Includes dust removal after sanding.

factor_modifiers.name: Elevated Ceiling Height (10-12 ft)
factor_modifiers.notes: 18% more time required for ceilings above 10 ft. Extension poles and ladders required.

factor_modifiers.name: High Ceiling (12-16 ft)
factor_modifiers.notes: 43% more time required. Scaffolding or lifts may be needed.

factor_modifiers.name: Very High Ceiling (16+ ft)
factor_modifiers.notes: Double time required. Lifts or scaffolding mandatory. May require specialty access equipment.

factor_modifiers.name: Open Floor Plan
factor_modifiers.notes: 10% less time required. Large uninterrupted wall sections improve efficiency.

factor_modifiers.name: Cut-Up Layout
factor_modifiers.notes: 18% more time required. Multiple small rooms, hallways, alcoves increase setup and transitions.

factor_modifiers.name: Hot Environment (>85°F)
factor_modifiers.notes: 11% more time required. Faster dry time requires faster backroll coordination. May need to work in smaller sections.

factor_modifiers.name: High Humidity (>70% RH)
factor_modifiers.notes: 5% more time required. Extended dry times may impact workflow between coats.

factor_modifiers.name: Heavy Construction Dust
factor_modifiers.notes: 50% more time required. Heavy dust from adjacent trades requires more thorough cleaning.

quality_effects.description: Standard prime. Single coat, standard inspection.
quality_effects.notes: Baseline quality tier. No additional time multiplier on tasks.

quality_effects.description: Enhanced prime. Adds formal inspection, touch-up, and post-prime sanding.
quality_effects.notes: No multiplier on base tasks. Additional labor from inspection/sanding modules.

quality_effects.description: Premium prime for Level 5 appearance. May use high-build primer. Full inspection cycle.
additional_rounds: Optional second prime coat if using standard PVA
quality_effects.notes: No multiplier on base tasks. Additional labor from inspection/sanding modules plus potential second coat.

combined_operation_rates.name: Spray + Backroll Wall (Combined)
combined_operation_rates.description: Combined rate for spray and immediate backroll as coordinated 2-person operation
combined_operation_rates.notes: 2-person crew: sprayer + backroller working in tandem. Effective combined rate accounts for coordination. Total labor = 2 man-hours per hour of operation.

combined_operation_rates.name: Spray + Backroll Ceiling (Combined)
combined_operation_rates.description: Combined rate for spray and immediate backroll on ceiling as coordinated 2-person operation
combined_operation_rates.notes: 2-person crew: sprayer + backroller working in tandem overhead. Total labor = 2 man-hours per hour of operation.

assumptions: Single painter unless otherwise noted (spray+backroll is 2-person)
Spray equipment is properly maintained and functioning
Drywall surface is Level 4 finish in good condition
Standard 8-10 ft ceiling height unless height modifiers applied
Adequate workspace access and lighting available
Factor modifiers are TIME MULTIPLIERS: >1.0 means more time required, <1.0 means less time required

risks.description: Rates not field-validated for this specific spec family
risks.mitigation: Track actual labor on initial projects and adjust rates

risks.description: Spray+backroll coordination varies by crew experience
risks.impact: Inexperienced crews may require more time
risks.mitigation: Use conservative rates for unknown crews

validation_plan.purpose: Calibrate base production rates against actual labor

validation_plan.item: Compare pre-trim vs post-trim cut-in times
